title: Reject Resolution Routes by Plan Class — Prescription Insurance on File
content:
Every claim rejection under **Prescription Insurance on File** carries a reject reason, and each plan class names the pharmacy-side route that resolves each reason. The table gives the route for every reject reason and every class.

| Reject reason | Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | Medicare Part D Standard Plan, Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan, Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | Commercial Copay Plan | Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prior authorization required | Electronic prior authorization | Electronic prior authorization | Electronic prior authorization | Electronic prior authorization | Adjuster review |
| Product not covered | Electronic prior authorization | Transition fill or coverage determination | Formulary exception request | Formulary exception request | Adjuster review |
| Refill too soon | Override code or wait | Override code or wait | Override code or wait | Override code or wait | Override code or wait |
| Plan limits exceeded | Bill within limits | Bill within limits | Bill within limits | Bill within limits | Bill within limits |
| Drug utilization review reject | Prescriber clarification | Pharmacist drug utilization review override | Pharmacist drug utilization review override | Pharmacist drug utilization review override | Prescriber clarification |
| Specialty pharmacy required | Route to Kestrel specialty pharmacy | Route to Kestrel specialty pharmacy | Route to Kestrel specialty pharmacy | Transfer to the plan's specialty pharmacy | Route to Kestrel specialty pharmacy |
| Patient not covered | Update coverage or pay cash | Update coverage or pay cash | Update coverage or pay cash | Update coverage or pay cash | Update coverage or pay cash |

The three Medicare classes share one column because their routes are identical for every reject reason.

## Where the classes differ

- **Product not covered** has four different routes: electronic prior authorization under the Medicaid class, a transition fill or coverage determination under the Medicare classes, a formulary exception request under the commercial classes, and adjuster review under the workers' compensation class.
- **Drug utilization review reject** goes to prescriber clarification under the Medicaid and workers' compensation classes and to a pharmacist override under all others.
- **Specialty pharmacy required** is routed to Kestrel's specialty pharmacy under every class except the Commercial Copay Plan, where the prescription is transferred to the plan's specialty pharmacy.
- **Refill too soon**, **plan limits exceeded** and **patient not covered** have the same route under every class.
